page.overview:
Who is Bly Tevin's grandmother?

The grandmother of the pilots Bly Tevin and Lina was an E'roni woman who hailed from the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh. At some point when she was young, she watched ships from the Outer Rim planet Eiram fly over the Rook, E'ronoh's capital city. She later told Tevin that she and others used the vessels' flyovers to keep track of time instead of using their system's Timekeeper Moon. While flying on an escort mission with Thylefire Squadron of E'ronoh's fleet Tevin relayed his grandmother's tale to his colleagues but noted that she might have exaggerated her story.

Bly Tevin's grandmother was mentioned in Convergence, a novel written by Zoraida Córdova as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's Phase II
